briefs.text: Landmine casualties hit a five-year high of about 7,000, Myanmar and Syria worst affected.
President Trump awards Rudy Giuliani the Medal of Freedom, America's highest civilian honour.
Washington is reportedly preparing new tariffs on China and 15 other trading partners.
India's Vaibhav Suryavanshi, 15, smashes a world-record 204 off 53 balls at the Rising Stars Asia Cup.

cards.body: A drone struck Riyadh's 80-storey PIF Tower, its second hit in under a week. Saudi Civil Defence said 11 people were hurt; the Saudi-led coalition answered with strikes on Yemen's Hodeidah port.
cards.headline: Houthi drone hits Riyadh's tallest tower again — 11 injured

cards.body: Third-quarter US growth was revised sharply up to a 4.3% annual rate, from a first estimate of 3.4% — the fastest pace in three years, on stronger consumer spending and investment.
cards.headline: US economy grew 4.3% in third quarter, beating forecasts

cards.body: Tehran's Revolutionary Guard said two tankers exploded after striking naval mines in the strait. The claim is unverified; attacks on shipping near Hormuz are at their highest since February.
cards.headline: Iran says two tankers hit mines in Hormuz

cards.body: China's Shenzhou-24 mission carried a Pakistani astronaut to the Tiangong space station — the first foreign national to fly aboard a Chinese crewed spacecraft.
cards.headline: Shenzhou-24 lifts off with first Pakistani astronaut

cards.body: Beijing's anti-corruption watchdog is investigating Politburo member and Shanghai party secretary Chen Jining — the most senior official felled in the biggest party shake-up in decades.
cards.headline: Shanghai party chief Chen Jining under graft probe

cards.body: A US federal jury convicted China's Huawei in a criminal trial over trade-secret theft and its dealings with Iran, capping years of legal battles.
cards.headline: US jury convicts Huawei of stealing trade secrets

footer: Compiled from agency reports — AFP · AP · Reuters · US BEA · The National · SCMP · Japan Times

lead.body: The Federal Reserve's preferred inflation gauge, core PCE, rose 3.3% in the year to October — above forecasts and the highest since November 2023. Headline inflation hit 3.8%. Nasdaq futures fell about 3% as a December rate hike looked all but certain.
lead.headline: Core US inflation hits 3.3%, the highest in three years

tagline: One day of world news, in one picture
